canada.title: Q&A: Premier Danielle Smith says she doesn’t need Alberta separatists’ support
canada.summary: Alberta Premier Danielle Smith says she has told members of her party to back the province’s referendum results, or leave. In an interview with CBC’s West of Centre, she says she doesn’t need separatists to get re-elected.

canada.title: Duelling petitions highlight rift over paroled murderer at McGill law school
canada.summary: Students at McGill University's law faculty remain divided over the presence of a convicted murderer in the classroom, with a new counter-petition outlining why some students feel unsafe and don't want him in their presence.

canada.title: First Nations leaders voice priorities ahead of historic meeting in Ottawa
canada.summary: First Nations leaders are preparing for a historic meeting with Prime Minister Mark Carney and the nation’s premiers, the first of its kind in more than two decades.

canada.title: Halloween candy sales are off to a slow start amid high chocolate prices and affordability concerns
canada.summary: Halloween candy sales are off to a slow start this year as U.S. consumers grapple with high living costs and eye-popping chocolate prices.

canada.title: ‘Savage and brutal,’ Erickson home invasion nets 17-year sentence
canada.summary: BRANDON — A woman who fought off the man who slashed her throat in a random home invasion in Erickson described the violent assault as the worst day of her life and a nightmare she can’t seem to shake off.

canada.title: Security under magnifying glass after suspicious death on Mountain Avenue
canada.summary: Homicide detectives are investigating the suspicious death of a 70-year-old man at a seniors high-rise on Mountain Avenue.

canada.title: Why some Ontario voters are turning to AI chatbots for 2026 municipal elections
canada.summary: Experts say turning to AI for election information marks a troubling shift in the democratic process, where citizen engagement and human judgment is superseded by some algorithms that could be providing false information.

canada.title: Voters head to the polls for B.C. provincial election

canada.title: Low taxes, big projects: Salmon Arm’s new council sets priorities

canada.title: From horses to electric cars: Sask. couple sees world transform over 75-year marriage
canada.summary: Helen and Larry Frey of Fort Qu'Appelle, Sask., have not only witnessed growth in their relationship, but growth in the world around them over the quarter-century of their marriage.

canada.title: Former Yukon chief land claims negotiator and territorial court judge Barry Stuart dies at 83
canada.summary: An adopted citizen of Carcross/Tagish First Nation’s Deisheetaan clan, Stuart helped pioneer restorative justice practices in the territory and was also at the forefront of the Yukon's pivotal land claims negotiations in the '80s.

canada.title: Shale rock, the geological picture
canada.summary: A lot may have changed in New Brunswick in the 12 years since a moratorium was imposed on shale gas exploration. But one thing hasn’t: what’s under our feet.

canada.title: 'Quite frustrating': Demand surges for N.S. fall vaccine appointments
canada.summary: After a week of trying to book COVID-19 and flu shots for her and her husband, Sue Earle finally succeeded, but they must wait until Nov. 17. Nova Scotia health officials say vaccine demand has been strong, but new appointments are opening up regularly.

canada.title: Halifax Water breach raises questions about ethical hacking
canada.summary: A third-party security tip dismissed as spam by Halifax Water is raising questions about ethical hacking and how organizations handle unauthorized vulnerability reports.

canada.title: 97-year-old's tribute to Terry Fox among quilts on display at St. John's event
canada.summary: A grand display of craft work is on now through Saturday at the Anglican Cathedral of St. John the Baptist in St. John's.

canada.title: 82 days later, no repairs started on washed-out road dividing small Quebec town
canada.summary: Residents in L’Ascension, Que., are still waiting on repairs after August flooding washed away part of their main road. The municipality's mayor blames the delay for repairs on the bureaucracy of different levels of government.
